messages:
sara_sales: Heads up — Emberly Health is asking for a bespoke rate for the POC -> potential enterprise. They want a 6mo dedicated commit and asked if we can do 45% off list for the first 6 months to get them past procurement. Security SQ in progress but slow (they requested SOC2 + enclave details). 
aj_dealdesk: +1 on needing more context. What’s the ARR/opportunity size if this converts? Do we have precedent for 45% on a short commit?
maria_finance: Need expected ARR and expected committed $ over 6mo. Also, payment terms? Net30 vs Net45 changes margin math.
sara_sales: Opportunity ~ $420k ARR run-rate if they go to prod. For the POC they want a 6mo reserved pool (dedicated GPUs) expected usage ~3.5M tokens/mo. They’re pushing for Net60 but we should hold Net30.
aj_dealdesk: We generally cap bespoke discounts on reserved capacity. 45% is outside standard. Can you capture a quick one-liner business case we can attach to the approval? (e.g., strategic healthcare anchor customer / reference).
sara_sales: Business case: strategic healthcare anchor, potential to rollout to 12 hospitals, strong reference value in HIPAA space. They committed to a technical exec sponsor and will run a pilot with 3 hospitals in Q3.
pricing_bot: Policy check: Dedicated commit discounts by tier: 1) <=25% auto-approve; 2) 26-35% requires DealDesk + Finance; 3) >35% requires Exec Approval and Legal review. 
dan_engineer: Technical note — the POC needs dedicated capacity due to latency SLOs and KV-cache isolation. We can offer a reduced throughput plan during POC to lower costs (cap concurrency to 4 v/s 8). That would save ~18% on infra spend for them.
kyle_se: Also recommend adding a small usage buffer (10%) to avoid throttles. I can preconfigure the instance and provide a runbook.
maria_finance: If they insist on Net60 that eats cashflow; for 6mo commit with a 6mo discount runway, finance would need either 1) upfront partial payment (50%) or 2) a letter of credit. Which can we get?
sara_sales: They’re leaning to partial upfront. I put a note in the SOW draft: `50% upfront, remainder on Net30` and escalated to their procurement.
aj_dealdesk: Ok here's a proposed conditional approval: we can do 35% off list on Dedicated Reserved for first 6 months contingent on: - 6mo minimum reserve commit (signed SOW) - 50% upfront payment - Security checklist status (SOC2 in progress, we need attestation or PO signed with security addendum) - Limit to 1 reference site for 6 months (we can revisit at renewal)
maria_finance: 35% with 50% upfront and Net30 remainder = acceptable to finance. Add a clawback clause if they break commit.
dan_engineer: From infra side we can implement the reduced throughput and the 10% buffer. Will need SE time during handoff (2 days).
kyle_se: I’ll prep the runbook and the quickstart link: https://redwood.internal/pocts/emberly 
sara_sales: Sounds good. I’ll send the revised SOW with the 35% discount and payment terms and route to legal for the security addendum and to procurement.
aj_dealdesk: Marking as approved at Deal Desk level for 35% w/conditions. @maria_finance please confirm final sign-off when SOW landed. Also loop in @legal for the security terms. :thumbsup:
maria_finance: Confirmed — will do final check once SOW is received.
sara_sales: Thanks all — proceeding to send SOW now. Will ping when countersigned. :rocket:
